series_annotator.narrative: The series exhibits a downward trend with moderate strength and moderate seasonality, but is characterized by high noise (spectral entropy 0.941) and unpredictable behavior. Unstable rankings (Kendall tau -0.2865) and concept drift further complicate modeling. A baseline strategy with robust median aggregation is recommended to handle the high noise and unstable model performance, avoiding stacking methods that assume model diversity.

reasoning.robust_median: series_profile.combination_recommendation.method_hint=robust_median → high noise and unpredictable behavior (noise.unpredictable=true) make robust median aggregation preferable to mean for outlier resistance
reasoning.inverse_rmse_weights_k4_sh0.35: series_profile.model_landscape.rankings_stable=false (kendall_tau=-0.2865) → soft combiners with shrinkage (recommended_knobs.shrinkage=0.35) are more robust to unstable rankings; top_k=4 aligns with recommended_knobs.top_k=4
reasoning.ade_dynamic_error_beta0.5_trim0.8: series_profile.model_landscape.concept_drift=true → ADE-inspired dynamic error weighting adapts to changing model performance patterns, per strategy_guide.decision_rules for concept drift

excluded_highlights.ridge_stacking_l250_topk3: series_profile.combination_recommendation.avoid=ridge_stacking → stacking methods are explicitly excluded due to model redundancy (models_redundant=true) and high noise
